caseName: Osage Wind, LLC v. Osage Minerals Council
caseNameFull: OSAGE WIND, LLC v. OSAGE MINERALS COUNCIL.

opinions.text: Motion of American Wind Energy Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Osage County Farm Bureau, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
